input_grain: individual x automatically delineated staging context x decision date
leakage_guards: one row per individual x context x decision_date
movement context must come from frozen automatic movepp preprocessing
context must be St_Lawrence, Nunavik, or Baffin and derive from source-backed region geometry
primary_formula: depart_next_24h ~ local_temp_anom3 * z_predictive_connectivity + day_of_year_within_context + wind_support + precipitation + same_day_temp_anom + C(context) + C(year)
primary_uncertainty: individual-clustered; two-way individual x year only as sensitivity when software permits
primary_support_rule: interaction estimate > 0 and two-sided 95% individual-clustered CI excludes zero

secondary_threshold.threshold_formula: depart_next_24h ~ local_temp_anom3 * cue_active + z_predictive_connectivity + day_of_year_within_context + wind_support + precipitation + same_day_temp_anom + C(context) + C(year)
secondary_threshold.no_threshold_formula: depart_next_24h ~ local_temp_anom3 * z_predictive_connectivity + day_of_year_within_context + wind_support + precipitation + same_day_temp_anom + C(context) + C(year)
secondary_threshold.fold_metric: mean binary log loss within held-out individual
secondary_threshold.aggregate: unweighted mean of individual fold log losses
secondary_threshold.se: paired one-SE rule uses sample SD of per-individual adjacent-minus-selected fold log-loss differences divided by sqrt(number of individuals)
support_rule: every frozen q-grid candidate is estimable on the same held-out individuals
best mean LOIO log loss is lower than the continuous no-threshold model
for each immediate adjacent q, paired mean held-out-individual loss difference (adjacent - selected) exceeds one SE of those paired differences
fail_closed_estimability: if any LOIO held-out context or year level is absent from its training fold, report THRESHOLD_NOT_IDENTIFIED
if any candidate threshold yields no cue_active variation in a training fold, report THRESHOLD_NOT_IDENTIFIED
if a binomial fit does not converge, report threshold secondary as not identified rather than retuning the grid or formula
secondary_threshold.pairing_unit: held-out individual; identical folds across all q candidates and no-threshold comparator
secondary_threshold.adjudication: paired across the same LOIO individual folds to remove between-individual prediction difficulty from the 1-SE comparison

amendment_to_parent_registration.issue: same_day temperature anomaly was listed as an immediate-weather control but omitted from the literal primary formula
amendment_to_parent_registration.resolution: include same_day_temp_anom as an additive control in primary and threshold formulas

validation.helper_unit_tests: threshold boundary, no-threshold comparison, paired one-SE adjacency logic, and incomplete-grid failure
validation.synthetic_integration_tests: registered estimability gate, primary formula fit, and climate-window leakage rejection

context_gate.rule: input context must be one of the three frozen shared route regions
context_gate.forbidden: per-individual movepp cluster_id or outcome-informed reclustering as context

required_precomputed_environment_semanti: predictive_connectivity_rho must follow frozen NARR trailing-window contract
local_temp_anom3 and same_day_temp_anom must use pre-focal 20-year NARR baselines
wind_support must use fixed region-centroid next-route bearing
precipitation must be NARR daily accumulated total precipitation
